call_budget.angle_calls: B only: one per accepted trial; canonical B = 4*N_a+32 each arm, Full B = observed accepted <=4*N_F+32
call_budget.event_requeries: one per B accepted trial; Full invokes original F3 event->packet; canonical original event(group,raw,child)
call_budget.packet_calls: Full original sample: one iff raw-valid, including coin reject; plus B angle requery iff accepted; frozen setup unchanged
call_budget.source_checks: shared file load/hash; per-pair setup; four sharing checks per pair; B overlay every operation; original F3 guards retained
call_budget.bound_semantics: exact scheduled sample count on success; variable path-dependent work counted, never force extra trials for coverage

seed_proposal.reuse: same prefix across A/B, correctness, baseline and instrumented; X/Y distinct
seed_proposal.old_128_trial_evidence: citation only; no reuse of old consumed claim or diagnostic seed

schedule_proposal.retention: all-trial compact exact-document hashes; full documents first 16/axis and failure context
schedule_proposal.constructor: one per arm/layer/phase-pass; share X/Y after initial/X/Y/final state/source identity checks
schedule_proposal.cache: no new law/packet/angle memo; frozen held state X/Y only; fresh process per pair; OS cache uncontrolled
schedule_proposal.order: correctness then baseline then instrumented; fixed arm order, A then B; own fresh Linux fork child per pair
schedule_proposal.angle: A ratio only; B every accepted event, no cache, Full original F3 requery and canonical audited requery
schedule_proposal.memory: own child /proc/self RSS samples every 4096 trials and own HWM/final RSS; not continuous RSS peak
schedule_proposal.output: unbuffered per-pair exclusive JSONL; exact hex rational payload, chain SHA and file SHA; no append
schedule_proposal.flush: Python unbuffered flush, not fsync or power-failure durability
schedule_proposal.overhead: coarse and fine exclusive partitions separately reconciled to outer child total; baseline replay separate

acceptance.initial_correctness: all 16 trials/cell complete; at least one accepted per cell; exact event invariants; B preflight and all requested angle checks; A/B trace identity; no extra sampling on missing path
acceptance.full_workload: exact N per cell per pass, R+C+A=N; no technical failure; A/B and baseline/instrumented exact event trace equality; correctness prefix equality; source/state guards; output chain/file SHA
acceptance.cost: coarse exclusive sum<=own outer total, fine exclusive sum<=own outer total separately; residual explicit; compare whole paired baseline/instrumented observations without equality/CI assumption

one_shot.starts_at: first authorized correctness construction/call after external atomic admission

admission: External approval port must atomically bind fresh B3_NEW_ claim and digest of adopted contract; not implemented or invoked as authority in this preparation
source_release_binding: Full future payload commit SHA adopted by user plus complete source SHA256 pins. Publication receipt identifies payload commit; no self-hash cycle.
